From: Bull, Kevin <kbull@freepress.com>
Sent: Friday, November 14, 2014 1:03 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: RE: Hanrahan 
 
James wrote it up already. George was trying to get it. Not sure who has reached out to.

From: Fenech, Anthony 
Sent: Friday, November 14, 2014 1:01 PM
To: Bull, Kevin
Subject: Re: Hanrahan
I emailed agent. Do you want me to write up or is George?

From: Bull, Kevin
Sent: Friday, November 14, 2014 12:10:38 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony
Subject: Hanrahan
George called in that Nightengale has tweeted about Tigers deal with Hanrahan. So he is making calls on that.

From: reynoldssports@gmail.com <reynoldssports@gmail.com> on behalf of Mike Dillon <mike@reynoldssports.com>
Sent: Friday, November 14, 2014 1:52 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Re: Hanrahan 
 
I can. Minor league deal. 1m w 2.5 in incentives. What has been reported is correct

On Nov 14, 2014 11:00 AM, "Fenech, Anthony" <afenech@freepress.com> wrote:

Is the deal major or minor league? How much? I won't use your name.
